_comment: Last-known-good Google review snapshot, refreshed automatically by src/lib/reviewStats.mjs on any build that reaches /api/reviews.php. Real Google reviews only - never hand-write entries here.

reviews.text: They were able to fix my locks instead of replacing them and saved me $$$$. They also showed up just hours after I called. Excellent, fast and reasonably priced service is hard to beat.
I got my car key fixed! Very fast and efficient! Thank u so much!

My experience with Raheim, at Armstrong Locksmith,  was exceptional. He immediately addressed and resolved my issues with rekeying the door lock to a new set of keys. I would highly recommend anyone to consider this business. He was kind, professional and precise. I will not hesitate to return in the future and encourage you to pay Reheim and his Brother a visit. Definitely a five star out of 5 stars.

I had an excellent experience here. I lost the key to my car and they were able to come out and program a new one. I had a relatively unique situation which they were able to handle without issue. The pricing was upfront and, while not cheap, was significantly cheaper than the dealership, OEM quality AND cheaper then other locksmith quotes I received.

I highly recommend Armstrong Locksmith
